from kfp.dsl import *
from typing import *

def produce(seed: str, dataset: Output[Dataset], metrics: Output[Metrics]) -> str:
    from pathlib import Path

    metrics.log_metric("accuracy", 0.875)
    metrics.log_metric("loss", 0.125)
    return seed + "-produced"
